title: Data Connectors: Permissions, Deployment Plans and Troubleshooting | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Who may manage connections and data sets, and how to copy them to another site, such as from staging to live, with a deployment plan. See the five permissions, how Manage connected data sets includes the refresh permission, the Data Connections and Connected Data Sets deployment steps, what to re-enter on the other site, and what to check when something does not work.

In this video:
• The five permissions of Data Connectors
• Setting them on a role in Access Control > Roles
• A deployment plan with Data Connections first, then Connected Data Sets
• What arrives on the other site: secrets are not copied, imported rows are not copied
• Troubleshooting: enabled, fields, permissions and the refresh history

chapters.title: Copy them with a deployment plan
